top_signals.title: Why the Bank of England museum is a one-of-a-kind
top_signals.summary: Where else in the country can you walk into a museum and without any guard present, lift a gold bar worth £1.2 million? Welcome to the Bank of England museum, one of the City’s hidden gems. Apart from the gold bar, a reminder of the 400,000 beneath you, the museum is a real treasure house, [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: BYD takes on rivals in Japan with its own electric mini car
top_signals.summary: Debuting a "kei car" puts BYD up against the country's biggest automakers in their home market, which few foreign brands have successfully cracked.
